t: You're at Pensioners' Court and Stable Court, part of The Charterhouse in Islington. These buildings were designed by Edward Blore, an English architect who was also a landscape and architectural artist and an antiquary. That mix of drawing, building and an interest in the past is the sort of background you'd want behind work at a historic site like this. I don't have further detail on the courts themselves, so I'll leave it there.
